description: Read a relative video path within explicitly configured BGREMOVER_MEDIA_ROOT and use installed FFmpeg/ffprobe to inspect decoded alpha samples. Supports VP8/VP9, ProRes, H.264 in WebM/MKV/MOV/MP4. Metadata alone is not proof. Read-only, max 64 MiB, 120 s video, 30 s processing; no full-frame audit or uploads.
name: inspect_video_alpha
title: Inspect actual video alpha samples
